findings.title: Account-erasure cascade not covered by a SQL negative test
evidence: 0001_initial_schema.sql references auth.users ON DELETE CASCADE for profiles
findings.impact: A future migration could break dependent-record deletion without any CI failure, leaving personal data behind.
findings.recommendation: Add an account-deletion cascade negative test to supabase/tests and run it in the migrations job.

report: Privacy: a user-facing notice (privacy/page.tsx) mirrors the recorded PIA/subprocessor register; account self-service export/delete exists (PrivacyPanel, tests); VERSION_ANALYTICS_POLICY scopes PII to UUID+opaque tokens. Residual: account-deletion cascade is implemented in SQL but has no dedicated CI negative test (creator cascade does).
